title: MetaSnap
tagline: Metamask snap to allow developer to view their transactions percentage before submitting it
description:
Users can inadvertently overspend using their digital wallets, whether due to unexpected gas fees or simply miscalculating the value of their portfolio. It's essential not only to see the exact amount being spent but also to understand that amount as a percentage of your total assets. If a significant portion of your portfolio is being transferred, this should be flagged immediately for your awareness!!!

Introducing MetaSnap: a streamlined extension that displays the percentage of your transaction, ensuring you never spend more than you intend
how_its_made: I recently started leveraging MetaMask Flask for a project. To guide my process, I followed a specific tutorial that was highly recommended. During the development phase, I used Yarn as my package manager and Typescript as my programming language. Everything was tested on my local environment.
